[strategy/guidance/security/Endpoint/GUID-SEC-ENDPOINT-ABB-MATRIX-2.4.11.md#status-definitions]

## Status Definitions

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Draft** | Authored and under review; not yet approved for enterprise use |
| **Active** | Approved and authoritative; teams SHALL apply this ABB to in-scope work |
| **Planned** | Reserved GUID; ABB not yet authored; represents architecture backlog |
| **Superseded** | Replaced by a newer ABB; retained for historical reference only |
| **Retired** | Capability no longer applicable; archived |
